notes.title: New Version 0.8.6
notes.content:
Recent changes:
* 0.8.6.0:
** Optimize performance on first start with HUGE steam libraries
* 0.8.5.0:
** Fix a problem with older (not installed) steam games. You should now see all games (tested with an account with 13k+ games :o impressive!)
* 0.8.4.0:
** Fix a problem with fresh tracking of installed steam games 

Thanks for your feedback!
